vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: ecommerce-review-analyzer
Version: 1.0.6

The ecommerce-review-analyzer skill is designed to scrape and analyze product reviews from Taobao, JD, and Pinduoduo. It uses OpenClaw's built-in browser automation to extract review data and Python libraries (python-docx, fpdf2) to generate reports. The login handling via QR code screenshots and the data extraction logic in SKILL.md are transparently implemented and strictly aligned with the stated purpose. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or unauthorized access was found.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions match its stated purpose (scraping and analyzing e‑commerce reviews) but it will access whatever account/session the built-in browser has—so only install/run it when you trust the skill and understand it will operate with your logged‑in session.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (scrape and analyze Taobao/JD/Pinduoduo reviews) align with requested binaries (python3) and the explicit requirement to use the OpenClaw built‑in browser for automation. Python is reasonably required for report generation (docx/pdf).
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly focused on browser automation to load product pages, detect/login via QR, scrape comment DOM nodes, and produce reports. This is within scope. Important note: the skill explicitly instructs using the browser session that 'inherits user logged‑in state' and will screenshot and send QR login images to chat — meaning it will have access to session cookies, pages, and any data available to that session.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction‑only skill with no install spec or archive downloads. Minimal risk from installs; dependencies are noted as pip packages in SKILL.md but no installer is executed by the skill manifest itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, no credentials, and no config paths. The only sensitive access is implicit: the built‑in browser session and any logged‑in account data it provides, which is proportionate for a web‑scraping review analyzer but is privacy‑sensitive.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and normal autonomous invocation settings. The skill does not request permanent/force‑included presence or claim to modify other skills or system settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for scraping and analyzing reviews, but it requires the OpenClaw built‑in browser and will operate with whatever account/session that browser has. Before installing/running: (1) only use with accounts you control or a throwaway/test account, because the skill can read pages, cookies, and comment content from logged‑in sessions; (2) be aware it may prompt you to scan QR codes and will capture screenshots necessary for login flows; (3) confirm you trust the skill owner (source is unknown); (4) monitor outputs for unexpected data exfiltration and avoid using sensitive accounts while testing; (5) if you need higher assurance, request the skill source code or a signed publisher and review network activity during a run.
